records.reason: Requirements-gated rider that makes the eidolon's secondary attack deal its damage automatically to an enemy — damage lands on a target, resolved at the table.
Starvation/thirst endurance over a week of downtime; the app models neither food/water clocks nor that fatigue.
Triggered reaction that grants the quickened condition until end of next turn — a condition applied in play, not a build-time sheet change.

A 1-action impulse that clothes you in a full temporary armor set (AC +3, Dex cap +2, check penalty -2, Speed -5, Str 2, plate group, noisy) which suppresses your worn armor's bonuses, plus a free steel shield. No field can express a granted armor set that replaces worn armor: a mode's modifiers can only add a bonus, and the net AC change depends on what armor is replaced. Sibling impulse armor-in-earth is equally bare.
Your mind weapon Strikes count as cold iron or silver; material only matters against a target's weaknesses/resistances, which is the target's side of the table.
A 2-action Spellstrike variant that deals line damage to other creatures — an action resolved at the table.
A 2-action Strike whose bonus damage scales with visible designated knights and which enfeebles the target; all of it lands on a target during play.

Raises the rank of the enlarge cast through Great Bear. Great Bear itself models only its frequency (limitedUses 1/hour) and carries no innate-spell entry, and the app doesn't sheet the enlarge effect's stats, so there is nothing on the sheet for the higher rank to change.

Retunes Shape of the Dragon's frequency from once per day to once per hour; shape-of-the-dragon is a tracked limited-use feat, and the usesUpgrade lane (incredible-luck-halfling pattern) delivers exactly this.

Your size becomes Small instead of Tiny. The dragonet ancestry record is size 'tiny' and build.ts raises body size from any feat sizeOverride (largest wins), so this is a plain sizeOverride the record is missing.
A 2-action area attack dealing damage to other creatures with a save against your existing class/spell DC — nothing changes on your own sheet.
A 1-action ability that makes a chosen unarmed Strike count as a metal until end of turn; the choice is made anew each use and only matters against a target's material weakness.
Extends the temporary size reduction of the Shrink Down action on the eidolon (Tiny, reach 0); a temporary in-play size from an action, and CompanionMod has no size/reach lane by design.
Gives your minion a social identity/disguise; purely narrative and GM-adjudicated exposure risk.

The feat carries a printed Frequency (once every 10 minutes) that nothing tracks. limitedUses supports the period multiplier ('every'), so the pips can show 1 per 10 minutes; the resurrection itself is target-side and needs nothing.

Your signature vehicle gains a fly Speed. Vehicles are a real CompanionKind in this app and COMPANION_MODS already carries speeds:{fly:'land'} grants, so this is the companion-mod registry lane, not engine work.

companionMod.note: Miraculous Flight: your signature vehicle gains magical propulsion and a fly Speed equal to its fastest current Speed (the app sets it equal to the land Speed — adjust by hand if another Speed is faster). If the vehicle already had a fly Speed, it instead halves the distance needed to make a 90-degree turn. The mod applies to every vehicle on the sheet, so remove it by hand from any vehicle that isn't your signature one.

records.reason: Reaction that disrupts an enemy fiend's or undead's reaction, using attack/spell attack rolls you already have.

At daily preparations one spell slot is held open as sheer potential and can later be spent on any known divine spell 2 ranks lower, acting as a spell of that lower rank. The app's prepared-slot model has no wildcard/flexible slot with a rank-shift rule, and no listed field (spellSlotBonus, effectChoices/spellFilter) can express it.
Grants the Mirror-Trickery reaction, which exists in the actions database and is resolved at the table; feats have no action-granting field and the reaction changes no statistic.

'If you have Smashing Tail, your tail unarmed attack gains the disarm and trip traits' — smashing-tail grants a strike named Tail, and unarmedTraits with a match list is exactly the lane for adding traits to an unarmed attack you already have (it applies only if that strike exists, so it can't over-grant).
Raises the DC of the flat check an attacker rolls to target you while you're concealed or hidden — a roll made on the other side of the table.
Free action on being reduced to 0 HP; it explicitly does not expend a use of Turn to Mist and is resolved entirely in play.
Lets the Water Strider action's movement cross air at up to 45 degrees; it is not a fly Speed (you still fall at the end of the movement) and the app has no surface-walking lane.
Grants the Mist Blending reaction, which exists in the actions database and is resolved at the table; it changes no statistic.
A 2-action combination that delays the multiple attack penalty until both maneuvers resolve — MAP ordering within one action, not the lower-MAP mapReduction lane.
A finisher action (Stride then Strike, or the matching movement type); resolved at the table.
A 1-action Stride-then-Strike with requirements; resolved at the table.

Raises the Speeds of the swarmkeeper's swarm. The swarm is not a sheeted entity here (no CompanionKind 'swarm', no companion grant on swarmkeeper-dedication) and its Speeds are used only by the swarm's own actions.
Half-Speed movement doesn't trigger reactions — reaction-triggering is adjudicated at the table, not a sheet statistic.

Envenom's frequency becomes once per 10 minutes. The app models that frequency as limitedUses {1, hour} on the prerequisite feat lesser-enhance-venom, and usesUpgrade supports the 'every' multiplier (stormy-heart / consistent-surge pattern), so the retune is expressible; the venom's damage is target-side.

Your dynamo unarmed attack gains the modular trait plus a chosen alternate configuration with its own damage die, damage type and traits (power driver, percussive striker, rotating sickle, entangling barbs, extendable baton), repeatable. unarmedTraits can only add traits to an existing strike, and grantedStrikes can't be presented as switchable configurations of one attack (the base sterling-dynamo-dedication strikes are even named 'Label'). No lane expresses a switchable strike configuration.
Grants the Decompose action, which exists in the actions database and is resolved at the table.
An impulse attack that damages and clumsies a target and creates an object with its own AC/HP; entirely target-side.
Lets you use concentrate actions during rage for a turn — an action-legality permission resolved at the table.
A Strike that forces movement and splash damage onto other creatures; nothing on your sheet changes.
Already delivered: the record carries maxHpBonus {perArchetypeFeat: 3, archetype: 'monk'}, the same shape as fighter-/barbarian-/champion-resiliency, applied in src/rules/derive.ts and build.ts.
Grants the Flurry of Blows action (already a record in the actions/classFeatures database); the 1d4-round lockout is a random cooldown no limitedUses period can express and is tracked at the table.

Downtime Crafting variation (use Survival for Craft, spend monster parts toward cost, use the monster's level for Price reduction) — the app doesn't model the Craft activity's economy, and the GM values the parts.

Adds cave worm/sea serpent (and phoenix) to the untamed form spell's shape list; polymorph shape menus aren't modelled and every sibling shape feat (insect-, ferocious-, elemental-, plant-, soaring-shape) is likewise fieldless.

Adds Monstrosity Form to your apparition spell repertoire — a genuinely new castable spell. grantedSpells (the repertoire-grant field) exists only on subclass options in types.ts, never on feats, and spellFilter can only grant a pick as innate or focus. No feat-level repertoire-grant lane exists.
Triggered reaction to move and Strike an unaware creature that is off-guard to that attack; resolved at the table.

'You gain the [Advanced Alchemy] benefits, and you can create 5 alchemical food consumables during your daily preparations' — verbatim the wording of the advanced-alchemy feat, which carries advancedAlchemy {items: 4}. The daily item count lane exists and this record has nothing.
Upgrades a Treat Wounds success to a critical success for a creature you treat; a result upgrade on an activity aimed at a patient, gated on a fact (no divine healing in 24 hours) the GM tracks.
An ikon imbued into a weapon that adds a 3-action transcendence activity; the transcendence is an action resolved at the table and grants no standing statistic.

Already delivered: the record carries maxHpBonus {perLevel: 1} (the Toughness shape), applied in src/rules/derive.ts and shown in explain.ts. The lowered recovery-check DC is a flat check rolled at the table and has no field.
A 1-action Leap-and-Mount; an action resolved at the table.
A 3-action attack dealing 10d10 with a save and imposing conditions on an enemy; all target-side.
Walking on liquid surfaces at half Speed with a per-turn failure condition; not a Speed entry and no water-walking lane exists.
Kingmaker kingdom feat raising Ruin thresholds; the kingdom subsystem is not modelled on the character sheet.
A 2-action Strike that permits a Steal attempt on a hit; an action resolved at the table.

'creating up to 4 versatile vials during your daily preparations' sets the versatile-vial daily maximum, exactly the resourceMaxSet lane used by expert-fireworks-crafter ({resourceId:'versatile-vials',values:[5]}) and additional-servings. The Quick Alchemy restriction to bombs/ammunition is a play-time limit with no field.
Grants the Engineer's Efficiency action, which exists in the actions database and is resolved at the table; no statistic changes.
A 1-action Strike-and-Step that leaves the target off-guard to your next Strike; entirely in-play and target-side.

'If you have the Hidden Thorn feat, your thorn attack gains the deadly d6 trait' — hidden-thorn grants a strike named Thorns, and unarmedTraits is the lane for adding a trait to an unarmed attack you already have (it applies only when that strike exists, and the thorned-rose heritage grants no strike, so no over-grant). The extra hourly Wicked Thorns for thorned-rose can't be expressed: usesUpgrade keys on a feat id and Wicked Thorns comes from a heritage.
Removes circumstance penalties and concealment flat checks caused by non-magical weather; the app models neither weather penalties nor those flat checks, and it grants no sense.
A 3-action activity that casts summon animal plus a composition spell you already have; it adds no spell and changes no statistic.
A 3-action aura that lets you and allies split incoming damage by reaction; all of it is damage routed between creatures during play.
Adds another kitsune heritage's alternate form to your Change Shape options; the alternate forms are appearance-level shapes resolved when you use the action.

Adds one spell slot (and repertoire spell) per rank except your two highest oracle archetype ranks — the identical sibling feats occult-breadth, divine-breadth and patrons-breadth all carry spellSlotBonus {perRank:1,exceptHighest:2,entryId:'<archetype>-dedication-casting'}; this record carries nothing. The archetype entry id is built as `${dedicationId}-casting` in build.ts, so oracle-dedication-casting.

You may hold one spell from another tradition in your divine repertoire (swappable, cast as divine). The repertoire picker is restricted to the divine list, and no lane lets a feat widen it: grantedSpells exists only on subclass options in types.ts, and SpellChoiceFilter.grantAs allows only 'innate' or 'focus', which would grant a use-limited spell rather than a repertoire slot.
